maddeler.e:
ينحصر (form VII)
# يَنْحَصِرُ (yanḥaṣiru) /jan.ħa.sˤi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# يَنْحَصِرَ (yanḥaṣira) /jan.ħa.sˤi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
# يَنْحَصِرْ (yanḥaṣir) /jan.ħa.sˤir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْحَصَرَ (inḥaṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
